notes: The cat-ear headband is now Waow's Band, and it is legendary. THE ID IS UNCHANGED, which is the whole decision: every player_inventory row already holding one becomes a legendary in place, no migration, no reissue, and no way to take it back short of going into the table by hand. Whoever rolled this hat as a common owns a legendary now. PASSIVE MOVES 15 TO 555 to match Warlord Helm, because passive is stored per item rather than derived from rarity, so leaving it at 15 would have shipped a legendary that pays less than a common and broken the one rule this catalog has. IT IS 60 TIMES RARER TO ROLL NOW: common was 1.31 percent of a drop, legendary is 0.02 percent, and every other legendary got very slightly rarer as the pool went 22 to 23. THE OTHER CAT EAR ITEM IS UNTOUCHED. There are two. Cat-Ear Beanie stays uncommon at 35 and stays in the crimson_wave set. The headband is the one that is literally a band, and it is standalone, so promoting it disturbs no set bonus. First catalog name with an apostrophe in it; every render path was checked and puts the name in HTML text or a double-quoted attribute. SERVER RESTART REQUIRED. Hard refresh.
